title: Rilakkuma Short Anime Gets 3rd Season
content: The new short anime of San-X 's Rilakkuma character ended episode 24 on Saturday with an announcement of the third season, Rilakkuma : Ki Mama ni Manpuku Biyori (Carefree, Well-Fed Days).

title: Ryō Kurashina, Issaku Wake's Jotei Manga Gets New Live-Action TV Series
content: Ryō Kurashina and Issaku Wake 's Jotei Super Queen manga is inspiring a new live-action television series which will premiere in the YTV channel's late-night "Drama DiVE" programming block on October 22.

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Series of 2026 Teases Its Epic Finale With a Final Trailer
content: 2026 has been one of the best years for anime , and the Summer season helped solidify that with a shonen anime that emerged as one of the best of the year. It is Black Torch , which has increasingly emerged as the perfect shonen anime with each new episode.

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Fourth Opening Featuring "88" by LM.C
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its fourth opening, featuring the song “88” by LM.C. The song was used in Episodes 74-101, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner
